basic_profile.bio: A lifelong reptile enthusiast residing in Austin, Texas. By day, I'm a software engineer, and by night, I dive deep into the world of herpetology. My interests span from competitive Pokémon battles to the intricacies of blockchain technology. I'm a big fan of indie music, particularly bands like Alvvays. I usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends. Currently single, I enjoy spending my free time exploring nature trails and participating in local reptile meetups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and a minor in Environmental Science, I have cultivated a strong foundation in both technology and biology. My expertise in reptile care comes from years of personal experience and engaging with communities both online and offline. Additionally, I stay updated on the latest in blockchain developments through self-study and participation in forums.
